name: quaill-control
title: Quaill control attribution and completeness layout (our addition)
source: Shape follows autoware_vehicle_msgs/ControlModeReport (mode numbering) plus a pseudonymous operator_ref and reason; session markers follow car EDR / flight-recorder practice. Written into the bag as three channels (see ros2_ws/src/quaill_msgs).
notes: This is the part no enacted rule has yet: who was in control, and when it changed. Proposed as a convention, not owned. Rule for recorders: the node that publishes the control mode must be the arbiter that decides whose commands reach the actuators, not a flag next to it.

items.name: Operator reference whenever control is MANUAL
